sources.title: Zero-Shot Transfer in AI & Robotics | Inference Systems
sources.snippet: Zero-shot transfer is the deployment of a machine learning model or control policy, trained exclusively in a simulated environment, directly onto a physical system in the real world without any subsequent fine-tuning or adaptation using real-world data. sources.title: [2602.15922] World Action Models are Zero-shot Policies
sources.snippet: State-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models excel at semantic generalization but struggle to generalize to unseen physical motions in novel environments. We introduce DreamZero, a World Action Model (WAM) built upon a pretrained video diffusion backbone.
